items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: “Oh it’s got lots of Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington and Count Basie.”

ctx.x: Oh God we get that almost every day. So, but it’s, “Oh my father just died,” or, you know, “he had a collection of 78s.” Mostly it’s LPs that they want to give us. And you

know, and they’re so convinced these are the most greatest most unique collection in the world, and, “Oh it’s got lots of Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington and Count Basie.” And I hate to always tell them, “Yeah, these are probably kind of common LPs. We probably have every one of them that he had in his collection too, and we just can’t take them because we have no space.” The space is not there.
